edges.label: the only US broadcaster to make the legacy programme a standing beat rather than an occasional segment
edges.note: NewsNation carries Ross Coulthart as special correspondent with a dedicated programme, Reality Check, built around long-form UAP investigation, and in 2026 ran a multi-part series with UAP Gerb covering FFRDCs, gatekeeping and the alleged Kona Blue material transfer. Broadcast participation in this domain reduces, in practice, to one correspondent at one network.
